svg.text: Umar Razzaq / Unreal Engine Developer / One connected cinematic world
A continuous route through the same complex. Every destination is also directly selectable.
Skills, technical profile and expertise float around a central core.
Four distinct worlds branch from one shared exhibition hall.
Experience unfolds along a skybridge with architectural markers.
The journey settles at a panoramic terrace with contact panels.
Ease in / out · 2.4–4 s between destinations
Level horizon · restrained parallax · skip travel
Damped hologram tilt · bounded magnetic UI
Particle repulsion · portal doors open on approach
Shared gold wayfinding and architectural modules
Airlock → control → portal hall → skybridge → terrace
All artwork, typography, portal frames and media slots are editable vector objects. Environment art is schematic.
Portrait is a replacement slot. Career companies / dates and project contributions require verified copy.
Visual direction follows the supplied .fig preview: charcoal, muted teal and warm gold. No site code changed.
APPROVAL GATE / Visual direction + spatial route + camera storyboard
Development starts only after design approval. Reduced-motion navigation uses direct cuts; the same world remains accessible.
